breaking_news.headline: The U.S.-Canada trade war is creating a headache for auto-parts makers
breaking_news.summary: For decades, the U.S. and Canadian auto supply chains have been tightly woven together. The trade war is threatening to unravel a complex system.

breaking_news.summary: In the Oscar-winning filmmaker's latest documentary, director Alex Gibney investigates the rise of Elon Musk and says what's behind Musk's success are distressing truths.

breaking_news.headline: US diesel prices soar past $6 a gallon, deepening strain for hauling everyday goods
breaking_news.summary: Diesel prices in the U.S. has hit yet another record, soaring past $6 a gallon on average as Washington's war with Iran disrupts the world's flow of fuel

breaking_news.headline: Is Patagonia the new data center hub? + Harley-Davidson's role in the trade war
breaking_news.summary: Why Patagonia might become a new data center hub

breaking_news.headline: Amid war and sanctions, many Iranians are losing their jobs and struggling to get by
breaking_news.summary: Many Iranians lost their jobs because of the war and the U.S. blockade. Now some are even losing their backup jobs as sanctions tighten.

breaking_news.headline: Anthropic and OpenAI CEOs call for AI development to slow down, OpenAI to delay IPO
breaking_news.summary: Dario Amodei and Sam Altman are the latest to urge caution amid fears the industry is racing too fast to build powerful AI while safety measures lag.

breaking_news.headline: A new tax incentive could lead to more films being made in the U.S. rather than abroad
breaking_news.summary: President Trump and Congress are weighing in on potential federal tax incentives for film production. It's hoped the tax credit would keep production of films and TV in the U.S. rather than overseas.

breaking_news.headline: The powerful millionaires hiding in plain sight
breaking_news.summary: They own car dealerships, law firms, dental practices, and restaurant chains. Collectively, these overlooked business owners hold far more wealth than the Forbes 400 — and wield considerable political power.

breaking_news.headline: Hyrox apologises for allowing race to continue after athlete soils herself
breaking_news.summary: Some raised concerns around hygiene while others praised the competitor's resolve to finish the race and push through adversity.

breaking_news.headline: Zambians warned not to eat dead wildlife after anthrax kills dozens of animals
breaking_news.summary: At least 12 people are being treated for anthrax after eating infected meat from wildlife carcasses.

breaking_news.headline: Malaysian boy acquitted for murder of schoolgirl on grounds of insanity
breaking_news.summary: The killing of the 16-year-old nearly a year ago had shocked Malaysia and sparked debate about social media.

breaking_news.headline: Six dead, 130 missing after Indonesian ferry capsizes in Java Sea
breaking_news.summary: Ships and helicopters are searching for those missing from the Virgo Transport 8 ship, which had encountered bad weather.

breaking_news.headline: Swedish left-wing bloc narrowly ahead with election too close to call
breaking_news.summary: With more than 90% of ballots processed early on Monday, the left-wing bloc was in front by approximately 20,000 votes.

breaking_news.headline: Thousands demand end to violence in Mexican cartel hotspot
breaking_news.summary: Culiacán has seen violence skyrocket since a feud broke out between two rival factions of the Sinaloa cartel.

breaking_news.headline: Russia hits Ukrainian train shortly after Boris Johnson and top European officials leave station
breaking_news.summary: The former UK PM said: "I don't know what warped logic drove Putin to blow up a stationary Ukrainian locomotive on the Polish border this morning".

breaking_news.headline: China criticises idea it is in 'malicious competition' over AI
breaking_news.summary: It follows the Anthropic CEO's calls for a slowdown in AI development - but in a way that prevents China from pulling ahead in the race.

breaking_news.headline: Trump downplays warnings of AI risks, citing rivalry with China
breaking_news.summary: The US president said "negative forces" were airing concerns about "things that won't happen".

breaking_news.headline: Amazon pauses work with cargo firm after fatal crash
breaking_news.summary: The 21 Air-operated jet overshot a runway at Miami International Airport and hit several vehicles.

breaking_news.headline: Carney gambles on the world's biggest investors betting on Canada
breaking_news.summary: In the midst of a trade war with the US, the prime minister leveraged his connections in global finance to invite some of the world's biggest investors to Canada.

breaking_news.headline: MPs and Lords call for new law to address AI threat to human rights
breaking_news.summary: Existing laws are not equipped to address the risks to human rights being posed by artificial intelligence, UK politicians say.
